name: 2007 - Cadillac WWTP History Note, Topographic Map and Aerial Photograph.pdf
description: Three-page historical site package: a note summarizing the 1995-1996 clarification, biosolids-storage and fine-bubble-aeration expansion plus the 2003 UV-disinfection upgrade, followed by a topographic map and aerial photograph. File metadata dates the package to 2007.

name: 2007 - Stantec Drawing 0P1.01 - Process Flow Diagram I - Cadillac WWTP 2007 Improvements.pdf
description: Stantec process-flow drawing 0P1.01 for the 2007 Cadillac WWTP improvements. The scanned drawing traces tertiary filtration, bypass, backwash, drain and related process-service connections.

name: 2007 - Stantec Drawing 0P1.02 - Process Flow Diagram II - Cadillac WWTP 2007 Improvements.pdf
description: Stantec process-flow drawing 0P1.02 for the 2007 Cadillac WWTP improvements. It maps return and waste activated sludge, equalization-basin drainage, ferric-chloride feed and aeration-tank connections.

name: 2007 - Stantec Drawing 0P1.03 - Process Flow Diagram III - Cadillac WWTP 2007 Improvements.pdf
description: Stantec process-flow drawing 0P1.03 for the 2007 Cadillac WWTP improvements. It documents process-service, sludge, air, chlorine-contact, sand-filter and influent-sewer connections.

name: 2009 - Cadillac WWTP Process Flow Diagram.pdf
description: Three-sheet Cadillac WWTP process-flow diagram printed from the engineering drawing set in November 2009. OCR was used to index the scanned labels while the original drawings remain the controlling source.

name: 2012 - Cadillac WWTP Maps and Flow Diagrams.pdf
description: Five-page WWTP history, site-plan and process-flow package. It describes the plant's treatment train and prior upgrades and preserves associated map and flow-diagram sheets; file metadata dates the compiled package to 2012.

name: 2014-10-22 - Cadillac WWTP Classification Letter.pdf
description: October 22, 2014 DEQ notice classifying the Cadillac WWTP, NPDES permit MI0020257, as a Class A wastewater treatment facility and describing certified-operator obligations.

name: 2015-01-21 - Wexford County Board of Commissioners Minutes.pdf
description: January 21, 2015 Wexford County Board minutes. The agenda includes the landfill remedial-action-plan area and related county business; the complete minutes are retained for civic context.

name: 2015-10-07 - Wexford County Board of Commissioners Minutes.pdf
description: October 7, 2015 Wexford County Board minutes recording discussion of a proposed landfill injection well, disposal of generated fluids, a planned public presentation and water-service concerns in the remedial-action-plan area.

name: 2017-11-15 - Wexford County Board of Commissioners Minutes.pdf
description: November 15, 2017 Wexford County Board minutes documenting an American Waste presentation on a proposed Class I non-hazardous injection well for landfill leachate, public comments and the Board's unanimously approved opposition resolution.

name: 2019 - Cadillac WWTP 99 Percent Flow Data.pdf
description: Six-page DEQ-created spreadsheet export of ordered October-November ammonia, CBOD and related flow-distribution data used for high-percentile review. The file metadata identifies a June 2019 creation date.

name: 2022-11-30 - Plant Sewer Lines.pdf
description: AutoCAD plant sewer-line plan dated November 30, 2022. The drawing maps foundry restrooms, laboratories, filter-press effluent, non-contact water, manholes and other internal wastewater connections.

name: 2023 - Digester Temperatures.pdf
description: Daily 2023 digester-temperature worksheet arranged by month. It preserves the operational temperature series and its source spreadsheet metadata.

name: 2025-01-15 - Digester Detention Times.pdf
description: Four-page 2024 digester hold-time worksheet using two 150,000-gallon digesters. It lists daily sludge input and calculated detention days by month; the spreadsheet was created January 15, 2025.

name: Cadillac Wastewater Treatment Plant Brochure - Aerial Photograph Cover.pdf
description: Nine-page historical Cadillac WWTP brochure with an aerial-photograph cover. It describes treatment performance and illustrates screw pumping, equalization, grit removal, primary and secondary treatment, rotating biological contactors, sand filtration, chlorination and solids handling.

name: 2026-07 - Cadillac Wastewater Asset Management Report — 2025–2026 Activities.pdf
description: July 2026 asset-management report covering Cadillac wastewater activities during 2025–2026. It records a 3.2 MGD design flow, 1.8 MGD average flow, 13 lift stations and 60.3 miles of gravity sewer; it also lists completed, planned and anticipated work and compares $5,635,500 in anticipated annual activities with $5,639,000 in wastewater revenue.

name: Sanitary AMP Map 11x17.pdf
description: One-sheet 11×17 aerial map of Cadillac's sanitary utility network with pipe-material symbology. The source does not state a reliable preparation or revision date, so it is retained as undated infrastructure context rather than assigned to a chronology event.
